summary: Updated clinical-lab-harmonization skill to cover transplant panel workflows observed in the trace. Added Tacrolimus to the conversion table, a transplant-panel sub-task section with specific join/conversion rules, and anti-patterns/troubleshooting for Magnesium over-conversion in transplant contexts. The trace showed the agent spending significant reasoning cycles on Magnesium unit detection before settling on a wide range; capturing this as a decision rule will save future agents time.
